policy: nominal CNY; year-end discounting; liquor EBIT proxy retains unallocated finance costs; consumption tax stays in operating cost; financial pool valued separately without double adding deposits or finance book equity
inventory_policy: existing pipeline assumed to support first five forecast years; new inventory funding follows revenue increments five years ahead; aggregate cost proxy, not proven vintage/tonnage rollforward
finance_policy: remove full standalone finance book equity from consolidated net financial pool as allocation proxy; add back only 51% at scenario PB; remaining pool haircut/allocation is a model assumption, not exact deconsolidation or distributable cash
minority_policy: nonfinance minority earnings proxy divided by liquor NOPAT proxy, scaled by scenario; apply to liquor enterprise and residual financial pool; not exact entity-by-entity ownership allocation
